method: Static review of locally cached, hash-verified vendor bundles. Vendor code was not executed, nothing was downloaded and no hardware command was sent.
offsetUnit: UTF-8 byte offset into the single-line minified bundle

sources.note: Pinned by earlier reviews; no local copy was available for this review. The command bytes are taken from the shared rzDevice25 definition below.

findings.meaning: Product feature flag that enables the Maximum Fans control. Product 671 main sets the same flag.
Maximum Fans is a Custom-mode profile setting, off by default.
User action handler. The control is user-facing, not a cleanup-only path.
Profile activation in plugged-in Custom applies the saved Maximum Fans setting.
Maximum Fans is Power Mode Control bit 0x02; disabled is 0.
Task runner writes bit 0x02 on enable and 0 on disable.
Before a non-Custom thermal setter (including HyperBoost mode 7), Synapse clears Maximum Fans.
In Custom, Synapse applies the thermal setter first, then the saved Maximum Fans flag.
Exported as _w (offset 1874739). Synapse reads Power Mode Control, replaces one field and writes the whole byte.

findings.text: new Uint8Array([1,7,143]),$=new Uint8Array([1,7,15]),k="Get Power Mode Control"
findings.meaning: Shared rzDevice25 binding: getPowerModeControl is 07/8F and setPowerModeControl is 07/0F, one data byte.
Shared rzDevice25 decoder: Maximum Fans is bit 0x02 of the 07/8F reply.

comparisonWith671.detail: The 669-policy action handler, bit enum, non-Custom clear, Custom apply, task runner and read-modify-write snippets occur once each in 671-policy (UTF-8 offsets 81398, 1382896, 1397809, 1399147, 1480892, 615078). The 671 task runner differs only in minifier parenthesisation. Both mains set hasMaxFanSpeedModeEnabled:!0.

sharedDeviceDefinition.pattern: new Uint8Array([1,7,143]),<id>=new Uint8Array([1,7,15]),<id>="Get Power Mode Control",<id>="Set Power Mode Control" and maxFanSpeedMode:2&t.data[0]

implementation.commands: 07/8F read; 07/0F [02] enable; guarded 07/0F [00] cleanup before 0D/02 when leaving Custom or entering HyperBoost.
implementation.guards: Fresh whole-byte 07/8F guard before each 07/0F; CPU boost, temporary full charge and local dimming bits block the write. Undefined bits and other lengths are rejected. Fixed fan baselines block enable. Independent readback after each write; uncertain submission pauses writes without replay.
implementation.acknowledgement: RZ09-0482 keeps its existing echoed set-acknowledgement contract; the status-only acknowledgement admitted for 029F/02A0 is not inherited.
implementation.hyperBoost: HyperBoost entry clears an active Maximum Fans bit with the same guard instead of refusing. The 1.1.1.3 MCU minimum and cooling-pad admission are unchanged.
